title: primula matthioli subsp. pekinensis
intro: Primula matthioli subsp. pekinensis, commonly known as Chinese primrose, is a plant species that belongs to the Primulaceae family. This plant is used in traditional Chinese medicine and is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antibacterial properties. Primula matthioli subsp. pekinensis is also used to treat various health conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and cough, due to its therapeutic actions including expectorant, anti-pyretic, and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
